message.content: {"note_claim": "McConnell is alive; his office stated on July 2 that he continues to improve in the hospital and is working with his staff.", "label": "SUPPORTS", "quote": "\"The Senator continues to improve, and is working closely with his staff on Kentucky and Senate matters while the Senate is out of session,\" the statement continued.", "reason": "The People article, published July 2, 2026, reports the office's statement that McConnell continues to improve in the hospital and is working with his staff, directly substantiating the note's claim."}

parsed.note_claim: McConnell is alive; his office stated on July 2 that he continues to improve in the hospital and is working with his staff.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: "The Senator continues to improve, and is working closely with his staff on Kentucky and Senate matters while the Senate is out of session," the statement continued.
parsed.reason: The People article, published July 2, 2026, reports the office's statement that McConnell continues to improve in the hospital and is working with his staff, directly substantiating the note's claim.
